notes: Each notice in this section was read on the employer's own website on 27 November 2026 and links to it. Notices are hidden once their closing date has passed, so this list shrinks until it is checked again.
Social-media posts, third-party job boards and paid aggregators are not used: a notice is listed only where the employer publishes it on its own site.

Coverage on 27 November 2026: all 17 companies listed on the Royal Securities Exchange of Bhutan, all 50 organisations on the Civil Society Organizations Authority register (csoa.gov.bt), the UN agencies with Bhutan postings, and both national newspapers. Where an organisation has no vacancy page, a web search for notices from the previous 30 days was used, and the table says so.
